title: Cheap waist of time
text: Cheap waist of time. These were SOOO much smaller than I expected & so much cheaper than I expected.  Bought for a baby shower and ended up not even using them.  They weren’t worth the time we would have waisted on them.  One of the lanterns broke the minute we tried opening it & put the metal frame in it.  Which the metal frame also broke the second it was touched.  Just not worth the money or time.
